title: [spec-gap][R-07-040/041] CoAP proxy absolute Max-Age cache deadlines absent: no proxy cache in any stack
description: spec/07-transport-app.md:676-691: 'CoAP proxy caches SHOULD convert the relative Max-Age option to an absolute deadline internally (cache_deadline = received_at + max_age_seconds)'; 'Proxies MUST NOT serve a cached response after now() > cache_deadline.' Rationale: multi-hop cache chains otherwise accumulate clock drift hop by hop. ABSENT in all stacks: the only CoAP proxy is a pure forward proxy with no cache at all (python/src/lichen/coap/resources/proxy.py, 105 lines - Proxy-Uri forward/relay only); rg cache_deadline across repo = spec/docs hits only. Worse, the existing Rust observe-client freshness path uses per-hop relative ms (rust/lichen-coap/src/observe.rs:546,659-705 expires_at_ms from local now) - exactly the clock-drift pattern the spec rejects. Suggested placement: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/proxy.py cache layer keyed on (uri, CF) storing (payload, cache_deadline) with deadline check on serve; reuse lichen time source (GNSS wall-clock per spec 09 14.6); Rust equivalent in lichen-coap if proxy caching is added there. MUST half (R-07-041) is unimplementable until a cache exists; SHOULD half (R-07-040) defines the design. Worth one bead covering both rows.
